components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:var(--font-sans,"Inter Variable","Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC",sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;height:36px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:20px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms,border-color 160ms,box-shadow 160ms,transform 160ms;color:var(--color-text-white,#fff);background:var(--gradient-button-primary-default,linear-gradient(180deg,oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881),oklch(48.8% 0.243 264.376)));box-shadow:var(--shadow-xs,0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05));}.ds-button-primary{position:relative;isolation:isolate}.ds-button-primary::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;border-radius:inherit;background:var(--gradient-button-primary-hover,oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881));opacity:0;transition:opacity 150ms ease}.ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled)::before{opacity:1}.ds-button-primary:active::before{opacity:0}.ds-button-primary:disabled::before{display:none}.ds-button-primary:active{background:var(--gradient-button-primary-active,linear-gradient(180deg,oklch(48.8% 0.243 264.376),oklch(42.4% 0.199 265.638)));transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--ring,oklch(62.3% 0.214 259.815));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring,oklch(62.3% 0.214 259.815)) 50%,transparent);}.ds-button-primary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none;opacity:.5;color:var(--color-button-primary-disabled-foreground,oklch(70.8% 0 none));background:var(--gradient-button-primary-disabled,linear-gradient(180deg,#ebebeb,oklch(87% 0 none)));box-shadow:none}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[class^="ds-"]{transition:none;animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
BoardUI is the confirmed visual authority: neutral work surfaces, Inter, blue interactions, regular rounded geometry and restrained contact shadows. The system keeps dense administrative information readable while leaving the routing controls within reach.

The MIT-licensed BoardUI theme is adapted to the existing Vue 3, Reka UI and Tailwind 4 application. Reuse the shared primitives and application aliases so the light and dark themes remain coherent.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral canvas with distinct, opaque working surfaces.
Inter text with a compact operational type hierarchy.
Blue interactive states, regular corners and shallow contact shadows.
Responsive controls and explicit, readable data states.

rules.name: The Semantic Alias Rule
rules.body: Use the application aliases for surfaces and text; boardui.css is the final application mapping over the imported BoardUI theme.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep the implemented darker primary gradients with white labels, neutral-600 muted text in light mode, neutral-400 in dark mode, and amber-800 / amber-400 warning text.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use the local Inter stack for headings, body and controls; reserve the existing monospace stack for code and machine-readable values.

rules.name: The Contact Depth Rule
rules.body: Use the shared contact and dropdown shadows to separate surfaces; headers stay opaque and the application header has no backdrop blur.

dos: Do reuse BoardUI semantic aliases, the local Inter stack and the shared Vue/Reka primitives.
Do keep default controls compact and preserve their focus, invalid, disabled and reduced-motion states.
Do let available content width determine the upstream row layout and keep every routing control reachable.
Do pair status color with explicit text and distinguish unknown, stale, loading, failed and confirmed states.
donts: Don't reintroduce the discarded paper-and-ink palette, irregular outlines or replacement font family.
Don't lighten the primary button gradient or muted and warning text beyond the implemented contrast adjustments.
Don't substitute decorative panels for labels, values or actionable state explanations.
Don't treat fixture screenshots or preview snippets as evidence of live accounts, routing or quota results.
